the surface's `ranges` array stays parallel to `editor.screenplay.elements` — one entry per element, collapsed or not — so every positional lookup in the surface keeps meaning what it meant — not machine-checkable; human judges
every edit outside an omitted span behaves exactly as today, and the caret and keystroke refusals inside one hold in both the collapsed and the expanded state — not machine-checkable; human judges
a collapsed span never reaches the canvas, so the page canvas and the page count agree — the inconsistency IL-0075 recorded is closed, not documented again — not machine-checkable; human judges

the sepia is derived from the screenplayInk/screenplayPaper pairing and resolved with usingColorSpace, never an appearance-dynamic label colour on paper; it is legible on both papers and a test measures the contrast in both — not machine-checkable; human judges
expansion is surface state only — nothing is written to the document, the file or defaults, and a close and reopen comes back collapsed — not machine-checkable; human judges
the struck-through presentation is gone, not disabled: no strikethrough attribute is applied to an omitted element anywhere, and no flag restores it — not machine-checkable; human judges

no file under apple/eDraftEngine, packages/, apple/macOS, apple/iOS, apple/eDraft or the Xcode project changes; in apple/EDraftUI only StoryPanel.swift and its Navigator test change, TitlePageSheet.swift in particular is untouched; the foreign working-tree changes are left exactly as found — not machine-checkable; human judges
